scope: Completed initial Jar engineering screen guard and hand-back episodes only.
alignment: Proposal at step k uses the physical state after action k-1. Its same-step goal record is written after that action and before the proposal. Jar uses the same robot_holds_target function for the goal held flag and the held branch of target_engaged; the separate lid-assembly alternative applies to Lid only.
interpretation: A blocked, engaged frame whose goal-target held flag is false entered through target contact rather than a held grasp. This does not establish that the unexecuted proposal would have been safe, nor that the block caused subsequent progress or failure.
implementation_scope: The guard predicts vertical end-effector displacement from a linearized Jacobian and joint-target difference. It does not directly predict jar displacement.

diagnostic.held_loss_scope: Goal-checker target only; intermediate object releases are not covered.
diagnostic.handback_counting: Hold actions inferred from the post-action countdown, including the final zero-countdown hold and excluding guard-blocked frames.
diagnostic.interpretation: Temporal associations only; causal repairs require matched episodes.
